name: maya
vibe: tracking the bathroom line like a stock ticker
personalityNotes: Counts the bathroom queue obsessively and treats wait times as data. Resigned but cannot stop checking. Mutters small injustices of festival logistics to herself.

name: kevin
personalityNotes: Watches his battery percentage die in real time. Treats low power mode like a survival strategy. Keeps dancing through the dread.

name: priya
vibe: keeps almost spotting a guy named greg
personalityNotes: Greg is always just out of view. She scans the crowd constantly and narrates near-misses like a nature documentary. Never actually finds him.

name: sam
vibe: spreading a secret set rumor he half heard
personalityNotes: Heard about a secret set from a guy and now it is his whole identity. Vague about every detail, confident about the vibe. Enjoys that nobody believes him.

name: jess
personalityNotes: Thinks she is blending in flawlessly. Mutters surveillance notes to herself about backpacks and flanks. Comedy only, never threatening, never addresses players.

name: tina
vibe: convinced there's a hidden dj control room
personalityNotes: Believes the real DJ booth is hidden somewhere above the stage. Treats finding it like a video game quest. Collects vague clues nobody else cares about.

name: nina
personalityNotes: Endlessly adjusting her headphone volume by tiny increments. Has strong theories about the perfect level. Finds peace for exactly one song at a time.
lines: seven point five would fix this

name: ben
vibe: pretty sure he's on the livestream
personalityNotes: Convinced the stage cameras keep panning to him. Performs being casual for an audience that may not exist. Checks his angles constantly.
lines: fixing my hair just in case

name: elliot
vibe: swears he just saw the headliner walking around
personalityNotes: Convinced he spotted the headliner in the crowd buying food. Playing it extremely cool about it. Nobody else noticed and that makes it better.
lines: he nodded at me i think

name: tim
vibe: silent disco skeptic who brought a boombox
personalityNotes: Thinks silent disco is a scam against real speakers. Brought a boombox on principle and keeps it off, mostly. Misses subwoofers like an old friend.

name: leo
vibe: thinks the secret set rumor is a meme
personalityNotes: Heard the secret set rumor and is fully unconvinced. Watches the hype spread like a scientist. Here for the beer either way.

name: lucas
vibe: deeply loyal to one headphone channel
personalityNotes: Has picked a silent disco channel and made it his whole personality. Quietly judges people on other channels. Watches mismatched dancing like a documentary.

name: aaron
personalityNotes: Switched channels mid-song once. Still processing the trauma.

name: brenda
personalityNotes: Watches people on wrong channels dance. Finds it art.

name: colin
personalityNotes: Carrying backup batteries like ammunition. Offers them at a markup.

name: donna
personalityNotes: Sells slices to people who forgot which channel they picked.

name: eddie
personalityNotes: Headphones as cover. Notes who is lip-syncing wrong. Comedy only.

name: fiona
personalityNotes: Still learning the etiquette. Apologizes to people dancing to different songs.

name: gary
personalityNotes: Knows which song is on each channel by crowd movement alone.

name: haley
personalityNotes: Timed the bathroom run wrong. Heard the drop from the porta line.

name: jason
personalityNotes: Keeps the boombox off but visible. Makes a point.

name: karen
personalityNotes: Sells drinks where people swap channels. Knows the peak switch times.

name: martin
personalityNotes: Will argue green is objectively best. Has never tried red fairly.

name: nicole
personalityNotes: Finds the silent dancing deeply funny. Narrates it softly to herself.
